title: Inverse image of finitely generated module local systems on small sites
statement: Let C and D be small categories in the same universe with finite limits, equipped with Grothendieck topologies J and K. Let G : C → D be a continuous finite-limit-preserving functor. For any commutative ring R in that universe and any sheaf F of R-modules on J, if F is locally constant with finitely generated module values in the sense of [def-pe-etale-constructible-module], then the sheafified left Kan extension G^*F has that same property on K. No Noetherianity or finiteness of the underlying coefficient set is assumed.

source.place: Tags 00YV and 00XZ, inverse image and localization; applied to the finitely generated module local models in etale-cohomology.tex Tag 03RW(3)

proof.text: Use preservation of binary products to construct the natural isomorphism star(X) followed by Over.post G ≅ G followed by star(GX). Take mates under the constructed sheaf pullback adjunctions and forget ⊣ star to identify restriction of G^*F to GX with localized inverse image of F.over X. This is implemented explicitly as starPostIso, restrictionAdjunction and pullbackOverIso.

Apply the local-model predicate to the terminal object T of C. Continuity sends its trivializing covering sieve S to a covering generated image sieve at GT. For any V in D pull this covering back along V → GT. Every member W → V factors through GY for some member Y → T of S.

For that Y choose the finitely generated module M and trivialization F.over Y ≅ constant(M). The localized functor Over.post G preserves the terminal object. The constant-sheaf pullback comparison identifies its inverse image of constant(M) with constant(M). Use the comparison in the first step and restrict along W → GY. Cocontinuity of Over.map and its sheafification comparison identify restriction of constant(M) with constant(M). These isomorphisms give the required model over W, with the original finite generation proof for M.
